scope: P4 review findings before final acceptance

findings.detail: Front target follows personally observed moving robot while intercepting, then freezes for occupancy; no episode timer reset.
Robot timeline snapshots are resampled. Original schema3 does not retain per-row interpolation brackets. Export unknown instead of false, record derivation; never infer original timestamps.
Natural episodes occur on approach navigation legs round_3:robot_1 and round_6:robot_2. Report those goal durations in addition to the configured corridor and whole-demo metrics.
Separate GPU/domain did not isolate startup/teardown and asset resources. No timing or geometric protection threshold changed.
Fourteen individual IDs cannot initialize the one-person synthetic fixture. Initial mismatch was rejected; existing single-playful configuration used for five actual ROS fault tests.
